description: Break-Even Calculator — Offline break-even analysis: fixed= fixed costs, price= per unit, variable= variable cost per unit. Optional target_profit= (with tax_rate= % for after-tax targets), units= (profit, margin of safety, operating leverage at that volume), capacity=. Returns break-even units and revenue, contribution margin and ratio, units needed for the target, a cost/revenue chart table and price sensitivity. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_break_even
